afbbddaea4f11c3657c5de1a201deeccd5c30347.summary: News report on APT37 (also called RedEyes or ScarCruft), described as a North Korean espionage group believed to be state-supported. AhnLab's ASEC reported a new backdoor, M2RAT, used in phishing attacks from January 2023. The attacks exploit CVE-2017-8291 in the Hangul word processor and hide the payload in a JPEG using steganography. M2RAT provides keylogging, screenshots, command execution and data theft, scans connected phones and tablets for documents and voice recordings, and uses shared memory for C2 communication.

af5382a738e0ba6828563f846abc64453866376c.summary: A The Hacker News article on an NCC Group analysis says the Carbanak banking malware is being used in ransomware attacks. Compromised websites host installers that impersonate business software such as HubSpot, Veeam and Xero. The report says Carbanak has been used by the FIN7 syndicate. NCC Group counted 442 ransomware attacks in November 2023 and 4,276 so far this year, led by industrials, consumer cyclicals and healthcare. Corvus counted 484 new leak-site victims. Ransomware groups have moved away from QBot after a takedown, and Kaspersky reported Akira ransomware and Windows CLFS…
